messages:
maria: Daily async — what I did: updated Python SDK quickstart + added missing env var docs; fixed the auth example in README. Blockers: mac wheel build failing on M1 with audit error (see CI output), need help with wheels. Today: will finish sample-app README and ping reviewers for the quickstart PR.

alex: Thanks! link to PR? i'll take a look at the wheel issue later today. Can you paste the failing pip output?

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/412
Failure snippet:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for somepackage, which is required to install pyproject.toml
clang: error: invalid deployment target for -stdlib=libc++
```
I tried setting MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0 locally, still fails.

sam: @maria I saw similar on CI last week. Try adding `--platform macosx-11-x86_64` to wheel build or use cibuildwheel matrix for arm64/x86. I'll drop a small script in the PR.

rachel: Quick check: sample-app still referencing old endpoint in config.example. I can send a patch for that.

maria: pls do, thx! Also need reviewers: @alex @sam for code, @rachel for docs. Can folks reply with :+1: if you can review today?

alex: +1, I can review after lunch.

sam: +1, i'll add the wheel script and kick a new CI run.

ci-bot: CI failed on linux-integration (flake8): redwood/sdk/sample_app/main.py:45:1 F401 'os' imported but unused

maria: fixing now, thanks CI. I'll push a tiny cleanup commit and request re-run.

rachel: FYI i'm also going to update the quickstart.md to include a short troubleshooting section for mac builds.

maria: amazing — thanks team. If anyone hits the mac wheel problem, see the PR for the temporary workaround. I'll mark this thread resolved once CI passes and the sample app README is updated.
